name: Download, Unzip & Upload Files

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      url:
        description: "Direct URL of the ZIP file to download"
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      files: ${{ steps.files.outputs.files }}
    steps:
      - name: Download ZIP
        env:
          URL: ${{ inputs.url }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "$URL" -o archive.zip

      - name: Unzip
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir extracted
          unzip -q archive.zip -d extracted

      - name: Build file matrix
        id: files
        shell: python
        run: |
          import json
          from pathlib import Path

          root = Path("extracted")
          files = [p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]

          if not files:
              raise SystemExit("The archive contains no files.")

          # Artifact names must be unique. Since the requested artifact name is
          # the file name, reject duplicate basenames rather than silently
          # overwriting/colliding artifacts.
          basenames = [Path(p).name for p in files]
          duplicates = sorted({n for n in basenames if basenames.count(n) > 1})
          if duplicates:
              raise SystemExit(
                  "Duplicate file names found: " + ", ".join(duplicates)
                  + ". Artifact names must be unique."
              )

          print("Files:")
          for f in files:
              print(f"  {f}")

          with open(__import__("os").environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as out:
              out.write("files=" + json.dumps(files, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")

  upload:
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        file: ${{ fromJSON(needs.prepare.outputs.files) }}
    steps:
      - name: Download ZIP
        env:
          URL: ${{ inputs.url }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "$URL" -o archive.zip

      - name: Unzip
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir extracted
          unzip -q archive.zip -d extracted

      - name: Upload file
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          path: extracted/${{ matrix.file }}
          archive: false
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
